verdicts.reason: Both have the same faults. The wind-turbine icon, which was the focal point of the original, is shrunk to an illegible thumbnail and jammed into a cluttered strip at the top with the green, blue and red triangles. Those triangles were corner accents and now look like random scattered pieces. The headline is blown up to dominate the canvas, and the thin diagonal lines float aimlessly at the right. A sets the text flush-left at about x=35, which leaves a dead area on the right. B's text block is a little more centered and balanced, but the top strip is just as crowded and the icon just as trivialized.
